sn12.32:1.2: I 2 Atha kho Kaḷārakhattiyo bhikkhu yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn12.32:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Kaḷārakhattiyo bhikkhu āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avoca || ||
sn12.32:1.4: Moliyaphagguno āvuso Sāriputta bhikkhu sikkham paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto ti || ||
sn12.32:1.5: Na hi nūna so āyasmā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye assāsam alatthāti || || 4
sn12.32:2.1: Tena āyasmā Sāriputto imasmim dhammavinaye assāsam patto ti ||
sn12.32:5.1: Atha kho Kaḷārakhattiyo bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 7 Ekam antam nisinno kho Kaḷārakhattiyo bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.32:5.3: khīṇā jati vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmīti || || 8
sn12.32:6.1: Atha kho Bhagavā aññataram bhikkhum āmantesi || ||
sn12.32:6.2: Ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena Sāriputtam āmantehi ||
sn12.32:6.4: Evam bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato paṭisutvā yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avoca ||
sn12.32:6.6: Evam āvuso ti kho āyasmā Sāriputto tassa bhikkhuno paṭisutvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 11 Ekam antam nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Sāriputtaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn12.32:6.7: Saccaṃ kira tayā Sāriputta aññā vyākatā
sn12.32:6.8: khīnā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmīti || ||
sn12.32:6.9: Na kho bhante etehi padehi etehi vyañjanehi attho vutto ti || 12
sn12.32:6.10: Yena kenaci pi Sāriputta pariyāyena kulaputto aññaṃ vyākaroti || atha kho vyākatam vyākatato daṭṭhabbanti || || 13
sn12.32:6.11: Nanu aham pi bhante evam vadāmi
sn12.32:6.12: Na kho bhante etehi padehi etehi vyañjanehi attho vutto ti || || 14
sn12.32:7.2: Kathaṃ jānatā pana tayā āvuso Sāriputta katham passatā aññā vyākatā
sn12.32:7.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti ||
sn12.32:7.4: Evam puṭṭho tvaṃ Sāriputta kinti vyākareyyāsīti || || 15

sn12.32:8.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmīti

sn12.32:8.7: khīnā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmī ti || ||
sn12.32:9.1: Sace pana taṃ Sāriputta evam puccheyyuṃ || ||
sn12.32:9.2: Jāti panāvuso Sāriputta kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃ jātikā kimpabhavāti ||
sn12.32:9.3: evam puṭṭho tvaṃ Sāriputta kinti vyākareyyāsīti || || 18

sn12.32:9.7: Jāti kho āvuso bhavanidānā bhavasamudayā bhavajātikā bhavapabhavāti ||
sn12.32:10.1: Sace pana taṃ Sāriputta evaṃ puccheyyuṃ ||
sn12.32:10.2: Bhavo panāvuso Sariputto kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kimpabhavoti ||
sn12.32:10.3: evam puṭṭho tvaṃ Sāriputta kinti vyākareyyāsīti || || 20

sn12.32:10.7: Bhavo kho āvuso upādānanidāno upādānasamudayo upādānajātiko upādāna pabhāvoti ||
sn12.32:11.1: Sace pana taṃ Sāriputta evam puccheyyuṃ ||
sn12.32:11.3: Sa ce pana taṃ Sāriputta evaṃ puccheyyuṃ ||
sn12.32:11.4: Taṇhā panāvuso kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃ pabhavāti ||
sn12.32:11.5: evaṃ puṭṭho tvaṃ Sāriputta kinti vyākareyyāsīti || || 24
sn12.32:11.7: Taṇhā panāvuso Sāriputta kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kimpabhavāti ||
sn12.32:11.9: Taṇhā kho āvuso vedanānidānā vedanāsamudayā vedanājātikā vedanāpabhavāti ||
sn12.32:12.2: Kathaṃ jānato pana te āvuso Sāriputta katham passato yā vedanā sunandī sā na upaṭṭhāsīti ||
sn12.32:12.3: evam puṭṭho tvaṃ Sāriputta kinti vyākareyyāsīti || || 26
sn12.32:12.5: Kathaṃ jānato pana te āvuso katham passato yā vedanā sunandī sā na upaṭṭhāsīti || evam puṭṭāham bhante evaṃ vyākareyyaṃ || || 27
sn12.32:12.8: Sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn12.32:12.9: imā kho āvuso tisso vedanā aniccā ||
sn12.32:12.11: vidite yā vedanā sunandī sā na upaṭṭhāsīti || ||
sn12.32:13.2: ayam pi kho Sāriputta pariyāyo etasseva saṅkhittena veyyākaraṇāya ||
sn12.32:14.1: Sace pana taṃ Sāriputta evam puccheyyuṃ ||
sn12.32:14.2: Katham vimokhā pana tayā āvuso Sāriputta aññā vyākatā
sn12.32:14.3: khīnā jātī vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyam nāparam itthattāyātī pajānāmīti ||
sn12.32:14.4: Evam puṭṭho tvaṃ Sāriputta kinti vyākareyyāsītī || || 30
sn12.32:14.6: Katham vimokkhā pana tayā āvuso Sāriputta aññā vyākatā
sn12.32:14.7: khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyam nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmīti ||
sn12.32:14.9: Ajjhattam vimokkhā khvāham āvuso sabbupādānanakkhayā tathāsato viharāmi || yathāsatam viharantaṃ āsavā nānusavanti attānaṃ ca nāvajānāmīti ||
sn12.32:15.2: ayam kho Sāriputta pāriyāyo etasseva atthassa saṅkhittena veyyākaraṇāya ||
sn12.32:15.3: ye āsavā samaṇena vuttā tesvāham na kaṅkhāmi te me pahīnā na vicikicchāmīti || 33
sn12.32:15.5: Idam vatvā Bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram pāvisi || || 34
sn12.32:16.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto acirapakkantassa Bhagavato bhikkhū āmantesi || || 35
sn12.32:16.2: Pubbe appaṭisaṃviditaṃ maṃ āvuso Bhagavā pathamam pañham apucchi tassa me ahosi dandhāyitattam || ||
sn12.32:16.3: Yato ca kho me āvuso Bhagavā pathamam pañham anumodi || tassa mayham āvuso etad ahosi || 36
sn12.32:16.4: Divasañce pi mam Bhagavā etam attham puccheyya aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || divasam paham Bhagavato etam attham vyākareyyam aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || || 37
sn12.32:16.5: Rattiñce pi maṃ Bhagavā etam attham puccheyya aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || rattim paham Bhagavato etam attham vyākareyyam aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || || 38
sn12.32:16.6: Rattindivaṃ ce pi mam Bhagavā etam attham puccheyya aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || rattindivaṃ paham Bhagavato etam attham vyākareyyam aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || || 39
sn12.32:16.7: Dve rattidivāni ce pi mam Bhagavā etam attham puccheyya ||
sn12.32:16.8: dve rattidivāni paham Bhagavato etam atthaṃ vyākareyyaṃ || || 40
sn12.32:16.9: Tīni rattidivāni ce pi maṃ Bhagavā etam attham puccheyya ||
sn12.32:16.10: tīni rattidivāni paham Bhagavato etam attham vyākareyyam || 41
sn12.32:16.11: Cattāri rattidivāni ce pi mam Bhagavā etam attham puccheya ||
sn12.32:16.12: cattāri rattidivāni paham Bhagavato etam atthaṃ vyākareyyaṃ || || 42
sn12.32:16.13: Pāñca rattidivāni ce pi mam Bhagavā etam attham puccheyya ||
sn12.32:16.14: pañca rattidivāni paham Bhagavato etam attham vyākareyyam || 43
sn12.32:16.15: Cha rattidivāni ce pi mam Bhagavā etam attham puccheyya || charattidivāni
sn12.32:16.17: Satta rattidivāni ce pi mam Bhagavā etam attham puccheyya aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || Satta rattidivāni paham Bhagavato etam atthaṃ vyākareyyaṃ aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehīti || || 45
sn12.32:17.1: Atha kho Kaḷārakhattiyo bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 46 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Kaḷārakhattiyo bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.32:17.3: pubbe appaṭisaṃviditaṃ mam āvuso Bhagavā pathamam pañhaṃ āpucchi || tassa me ahosi dandhāyitattaṃ || ||

sn12.32:17.5: Divasañ ce pi maṃ Bhagavā etam attham puccheyya aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || divasam paham Bhagavato etam attham vyākareyyam aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || ||
sn12.32:17.8: Dve rattidivāni ce pi mam Bhagavā || ||
sn12.32:17.13: Satta rattidivāni ce pi mam Bhagavā etam attham puccheyya aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || satta rattidivāni paham Bhagavato etam atthaṃ vyākareyyam aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehīti || || 47
sn12.32:18.1: Sā hi bhikkhu Sāriputtassa dhammadhātu suppatividdhā || yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā divasañce pahaṃ Sāriputtam etam attham puccheyyam aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || divasam pi me Sāriputto etam attham vyākareyya aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || || Rattiñce paham Sāriputtam etam attham puccheyyam aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi ||
sn12.32:18.2: rattim pi me Sāriputto etam attham vyākareyya || ||
sn12.32:18.3: Rattidivāni ce paham Sāriputtam etam attham puccheyyam || rattidivāni pi me Sāriputto etam attham vyākareyya || ||
sn12.32:18.4: Dve rattidivāni ce paham Sāriputtam etam attham puccheyyam || dve rattidivāni pi me Sāriputto etam atthaṃ vyākareyya || ||
sn12.32:18.5: Tīni rattidivāni ce paham Sāriputto etam attham puccheyyam tīni rattidivāni pi me Sāriputto etam attham vyākareyya || ||
sn12.32:18.6: Cattāri rattidivāni ce paham Sāriputtam etam attham puccheyyam || cattāri rattidivāni pi me Sāriputto etam attham vyākareyya || ||
sn12.32:18.7: Pañca rattidivāni ce pahaṃ Sāriputtam etam attham puccheyyaṃ pañca rattidivāni pi me Sāriputto etam attham vyākareyya || ||
sn12.32:18.8: Cha rattidivāni ce pahaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etam attham puccheyyaṃ || cha rattidivāni pi me Sāriputto etam attham vyākareyya || ||
sn12.32:18.9: Satta rattidivāni ce paham Sāriputtam etam attham puccheyyam aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehi || satta rattidivāni pi me Sāriputto etam attham vyākareyya aññam aññehi padehi aññam aññehi pariyāyehī ti || ||
